scope: Runtime and store-worker lifecycle, bounded work and cancellation
Notes editing and asynchronous session selection
Core transcript, request, persistence and backup paths
methods: Trigger/effect analysis with findings sent to implementation owners
Independent Levenshtein scoring of original ASR smoke output; see local inference report when available

findings.observed_trigger: Open session B while A is selected, then type before the asynchronous Open acknowledgement.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Changed-selection snapshot could overwrite A's newly dirty notes without saving.
findings.reviewed_correction: FIFO Switch acknowledgements gate the detail surface and set the already-focused notes TextEdit interactive(false).
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: A non-Notes command response arrives while notes are saving.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Any acknowledgement or error could clear notes_saving or attribute the wrong error to notes.
findings.reviewed_correction: FIFO acknowledgement kinds distinguish Notes, Switch and Other; only a Notes acknowledgement clears notes_saving.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Open a session with a different mode.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Toolbar could display the previously selected mode while requests used the newly selected session's persisted mode.
findings.reviewed_correction: Selected-mode state refreshes when selected session identity changes.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Mute a recording, pause it, then resume or start the active muted session.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Microphone hardware and ASR could restart while persisted muted remained true; core then rejected microphone transcript updates.
findings.reviewed_correction: start_capture returns before initializing audio when the session is muted.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Stop or start a new chat, then press Pause while final ASR is pending.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Pause could overwrite pending Stop; session stayed paused and new-chat continuation could wait forever for Stopped.
findings.reviewed_correction: A pending EndAction::Stop is dominant and repeated end_capture calls preserve it.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Final-utterance queue is full when Stop, Pause or Mute is requested.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Blocking final send prevented capture loop from observing stop; hardware could keep acquiring throughout queued ASR decoding.
findings.reviewed_correction: Final enqueue uses bounded try_send polling with a callback that stops hardware as soon as the stop flag is set, while retaining the queued final utterance.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Export a meeting under a normal Unix umask of 022.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Desktop export could create readable-by-others 0644 transcript/notes and leave a partial target after a write failure.
findings.reviewed_correction: Desktop and CLI use cueglint_core::files::write_private_export: private 0600 temporary file, sync and atomic no-overwrite publication.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Rapid screen-enabled asks or preview commands while native capture/OCR is slow.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Each command could spawn a new uncancellable native capture/OCR thread.
findings.reviewed_correction: Shared RAII single-flight permit bounds concurrent native screen capture/OCR; busy requests return an explicit retry error.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Change model directories repeatedly while verification is still hashing files.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Unrestricted hash-verification threads could accumulate, despite stale results being ignored.
findings.reviewed_correction: Atomic single-flight gate bounds verification; stale-root Models completion schedules verification for the current root.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Old-root installation finishes just before the model directory changes.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Queued old-root success could mark a profile installed in the new model root.
findings.reviewed_correction: InstallDone includes the installation root and only adds profiles when it matches the current model root.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Transcribe live microphone/system audio, then pause and resume.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Live GUI transcript discarded source sample times/model identity; naive metadata addition would restart sample times from zero and reorder resumed utterances.
findings.reviewed_correction: Live updates call upsert_transcript_with_audio, retain pinned ASR identity and source times, and add a session-relative offset on each capture start; source is not equated to individual speaker identity.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Model terminates with empty or whitespace-only output.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: UI could show cancelled while durable active_request_id remained Pending.
findings.reviewed_correction: Empty completed output explicitly cancels its matching durable request; terminal state is set before fallible completion writes.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Screen OCR succeeds but begin_request_with_screen rejects an oversized prompt or an exhausted request history.
findings.observed_effect_before_correction: Background error left runtime in capturing-screen state without another completion event.
findings.reviewed_correction: Request-creation failure clears cancellation handle and sets generation state to error before propagating the error.
findings.verification: Evaluator inspected corrected source; no live-device or GUI re-run by this evaluator.

findings.observed_trigger: Two sequential 1024-sample microphone packets at 16kHz have sequences 0 and 1, but start_ns values 0 and 60_000_000_000, as may occur across OS callback suspension.
findings.effect: Sequence/rate checks do not split the endpoint; its final utterance spans more than 30 seconds despite containing little PCM. Core validate_audio rejects that transcript provenance, so finalized text is not stored.
findings.required_followup: Execute the separately inventoried controlled real-device sleep/resume scenario; the 250ms source-timestamp tolerance has not been calibrated on live hardware by this evaluator.
findings.verification: Deterministic source trace only; no synthetic test execution or live sleep/resume run by evaluator.
findings.reviewed_correction: Endpoint tracks expected next source timestamp for every packet, including silence, and finalizes/reset state when discontinuity exceeds the explicit 250ms tolerance. A deterministic 60-second suspension regression preserves bounded utterance times.
